purpose: Verify an authenticated employee can create and submit a purchase indent
preconditions: Employee is authenticated; all required indent data is available
action_or_input: Employee creates an indent and submits it
expected_result: Indent is accepted, persisted in submitted state and visible to the employee

purpose: Verify item details, quantity, estimated cost and justification are captured and persisted
preconditions: Authenticated employee with an open indent form
action_or_input: Enter item details, quantity, estimated cost and justification and submit
expected_result: All four values are stored exactly as entered on the persisted indent

purpose: Verify submission is blocked when a mandatory indent field is missing and the missing field is identified
preconditions: Authenticated employee; draft indent missing one required field (item details, quantity, estimated cost or justification)
expected_result: Submission is rejected, no indent is submitted and the missing field is identified in the error

purpose: Verify a potential duplicate indent is detected and flagged for review
preconditions: An existing submitted indent exists; configured duplicate-detection criteria are known
action_or_input: Employee submits a new indent that matches the existing one under the duplicate criteria
expected_result: The new indent is flagged as a potential duplicate for review

purpose: Verify every submitted indent receives a unique identifier
preconditions: Authenticated employee
expected_result: Each indent has a non-empty identifier and the two identifiers differ

purpose: Verify a submission timestamp is recorded
preconditions: Authenticated employee; known system time
expected_result: The indent holds a submission timestamp matching the time of submission

purpose: Verify indent creation and later actions are logged in the audit trail
preconditions: Authenticated employee
action_or_input: Create an indent, then perform a further action on it such as modify or withdraw
expected_result: Audit trail holds separate entries for creation and the subsequent action, each with actor and time

purpose: Verify an employee can modify an indent in a permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state configured as permissible for modification
expected_result: Modification is accepted and saved

purpose: Verify modification is blocked outside a permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state not configured as permissible for modification
action_or_input: Employee attempts to modify the indent
expected_result: Action is blocked with an error and the indent is unchanged

purpose: Verify an employee can withdraw or cancel an indent in a permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state configured as permissible for withdrawal/cancellation
action_or_input: Employee withdraws or cancels the indent
expected_result: Indent moves to withdrawn/cancelled state

purpose: Verify withdrawal/cancellation is blocked outside a permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state not configured as permissible for withdrawal/cancellation
action_or_input: Employee attempts to withdraw or cancel
expected_result: Action is blocked and the indent state is unchanged

purpose: Verify each indent modification is retained as a distinct version
preconditions: Indent in a permissible state
action_or_input: Modify the indent twice with different values
expected_result: Original and each modification exist as distinct retrievable versions with their own values

purpose: Verify a previous indent can be repeated as a new draft and edited before submission
preconditions: A previous indent exists for the employee
action_or_input: Choose repeat-as-new-draft, change a field, then submit
expected_result: A new draft is created from the previous indent, is editable, and on submission is a new indent with its own identifier; the original is unchanged

purpose: Verify logged indent actions are visible to a stakeholder authorized for the indent
preconditions: Indent with logged actions; user is an authorized stakeholder for it
action_or_input: Authorized stakeholder views the indent action history
expected_result: Logged actions are displayed

purpose: Verify a stakeholder not authorized for the indent cannot see its action history
preconditions: Indent with logged actions; user is not an authorized stakeholder for it
action_or_input: Unauthorized user requests the indent action history
expected_result: Access is denied and no history is disclosed

purpose: Verify departmental and central stock are checked automatically before external procurement
preconditions: Submitted indent; stock records exist in department and central stores
expected_result: Both departmental and central stock are checked before the indent can proceed to external procurement

purpose: Verify the indent proceeds to internal issue and not external procurement when sufficient allocable stock exists
preconditions: Sufficient allocable stock exists for the requested quantity
expected_result: Indent is routed to internal issue and is not routed to external procurement

purpose: Verify the requestor is informed when requested items are present in system stock
preconditions: Requested items exist in system stock records
action_or_input: Stock check runs for the indent
expected_result: A notification reaches the requestor and is retained

purpose: Verify available stock allocated to an indent is reserved before internal issue
preconditions: Available stock of quantity N; indent for quantity less than or equal to N
expected_result: The allocated quantity is recorded as reserved for that indent before internal issue

purpose: Verify existing reservations are deducted from availability so stock is not over-committed
preconditions: Stock quantity N with a reservation of N for indent A
action_or_input: Indent B requests stock of the same item
expected_result: Available stock for B excludes reserved quantity; no allocation beyond the unreserved quantity occurs

purpose: Verify the Department Admin can schedule picking for an approved internal issue
preconditions: Approved internal issue; Department Admin logged in
expected_result: Picking schedule is saved against the issue

purpose: Verify the Department Admin can schedule dispatch for an approved internal issue
preconditions: Approved internal issue; Department Admin logged in
expected_result: Dispatch schedule is saved against the issue

purpose: Verify the requestor can acknowledge receipt of internally issued goods
preconditions: Internal issue dispatched to the requestor
expected_result: Acknowledgement is recorded and delivery is marked confirmed

purpose: Verify final stock posting occurs after delivery confirmation
preconditions: Internal issue with delivery confirmed and no unresolved discrepancy
expected_result: Final stock posting is performed and inventory is updated

purpose: Verify final stock posting does not occur before delivery is confirmed
preconditions: Internal issue dispatched but receipt not acknowledged
expected_result: Posting is refused and inventory is unchanged

purpose: Verify final stock posting is not completed for a receipt with an unresolved discrepancy
preconditions: Receipt confirmed but with an open discrepancy
expected_result: Posting is blocked until the discrepancy is resolved; inventory unchanged

purpose: Verify an indent below a configured cost threshold routes to the configured approval authority
preconditions: Approval hierarchy and cost thresholds configured; indent cost below the threshold
action_or_input: Submit and progress the indent for approval
expected_result: Indent is routed to the authority configured for that cost band

purpose: Verify an indent above a configured cost threshold routes to the higher configured authority
preconditions: Same configuration; indent cost above the threshold
action_or_input: Submit and progress the indent for approval
expected_result: Indent is routed through the higher authority path configured for that cost band

purpose: Verify a higher-priority indent takes the more direct approval path when policy permits
preconditions: Configured policy permits a direct path for high priority; indent marked higher priority
expected_result: Indent follows the configured more direct approval path

purpose: Verify a higher-priority indent follows the normal path when policy does not permit a direct path
preconditions: Configured policy does not permit a direct path; indent marked higher priority
expected_result: Indent follows the normal threshold-based hierarchy

purpose: Verify the Department Admin can record criticality/priority of an indent
preconditions: Department Admin logged in; submitted indent
expected_result: Value is saved on the indent

purpose: Verify recorded criticality drives SLA notifications and approval-queue prioritization
preconditions: Two pending indents with different recorded criticality
action_or_input: View the approver queue and let SLA triggers evaluate
expected_result: Queue order and SLA notification handling reflect the recorded criticality

purpose: Verify rejection without justification is not accepted
preconditions: Indent pending with an approver
expected_result: Rejection is refused, indent state is unchanged and a justification is demanded

purpose: Verify rejection with justification is accepted, communicated and logged
preconditions: Indent pending with an approver
expected_result: Indent becomes rejected, justification is stored, requestor is notified and decision is audited

purpose: Verify SLA-based reminders are issued for pending approval actions
preconditions: Pending approval; configured SLA reminder condition reached
expected_result: Reminder is issued to the pending approver

purpose: Verify escalation notification is issued when configured escalation conditions are met
preconditions: Pending approval; configured escalation condition reached
expected_result: Escalation notification is issued to the configured recipient

purpose: Verify every approval decision is recorded in the audit trail
preconditions: Indent pending approval
action_or_input: Approve one indent and reject another
expected_result: Audit trail contains an entry for each decision with approver, decision and time

purpose: Verify an indent is routed for external procurement when stock is insufficient
preconditions: Combined allocable stock is less than the requested quantity
expected_result: Indent is routed to external procurement

purpose: Verify direct procurement is selected when value is within the configured threshold
preconditions: Tender threshold configured; indent value below it
expected_result: Direct procurement is selected

purpose: Verify tender procurement is selected when value meets or exceeds the configured threshold
preconditions: Tender threshold configured; indent value at or above it
expected_result: Tender procurement is selected

purpose: Verify bids/tender invitations can be published for a tender procurement
preconditions: Tender procurement indent; PS Admin logged in
expected_result: Tender is published and its status recorded

purpose: Verify bids are received and recorded for a tender
preconditions: Published tender
expected_result: Each bid is stored against the tender

purpose: Verify submitted bids can be evaluated against the defined tender evaluation criteria
preconditions: Tender with recorded bids and defined evaluation criteria
expected_result: Evaluation results per criterion are recorded for each bid

purpose: Verify committee approval of the tender selection can be recorded
preconditions: Evaluated tender; Procurement Committee member logged in
action_or_input: Record committee approval of the selected bid
expected_result: Approval and selection are recorded

purpose: Verify procurement decisions and supporting records are retained and traceable
preconditions: Tender with a recorded committee decision
action_or_input: Retrieve the procurement decision and supporting records
expected_result: Decision and supporting records are retrievable and linked to the procurement

purpose: Verify a PO can be created after required approvals are completed
preconditions: Indent with all required approvals completed
expected_result: PO is created

purpose: Verify PO creation is refused while required approvals are incomplete
preconditions: Indent with required approval pending or rejected
expected_result: Creation is refused and no PO exists

purpose: Verify a PO is linked to its originating indent
preconditions: Approved indent
action_or_input: Create a PO from the indent
expected_result: PO references the originating indent

purpose: Verify a PO is linked to the selected vendor
preconditions: Approved indent; verified vendor selected
expected_result: PO references the selected vendor

purpose: Verify vendor master is validated and PO issuance succeeds for a valid vendor
preconditions: PO ready for issuance; vendor master record valid
expected_result: Vendor master validation passes and PO is issued

purpose: Verify PO issuance is stopped when vendor master validation fails
preconditions: PO ready for issuance; vendor master record fails validation
expected_result: Issuance is refused and the validation failure is reported

purpose: Verify the current status of each PO is tracked centrally
preconditions: POs in different statuses
action_or_input: View PO status centrally and move a PO to the next status
expected_result: Current status is shown for each PO and updates when it changes

purpose: Verify planned and actual delivery schedule information is tracked per PO
preconditions: PO with a planned delivery date
action_or_input: Record the actual delivery against the PO
expected_result: Planned and actual delivery information are both stored and displayed

purpose: Verify an authorized Requestor, Department Admin or Department Head can record inspection of delivered goods
preconditions: Delivery against a PO; user holds one of the authorized roles
expected_result: Inspection is recorded with the user and result

purpose: Verify a user not authorized to inspect cannot record inspection
preconditions: Delivery against a PO; user without an authorized inspector role
expected_result: Action is denied and no inspection is recorded

purpose: Verify a GRN is created for a recorded delivery
preconditions: Delivery recorded and inspected
expected_result: GRN exists and references the delivery and PO

purpose: Verify a partial receipt can be recorded against a PO
preconditions: PO for quantity N
action_or_input: Record receipt of quantity less than N
expected_result: Partial receipt is recorded and the remaining quantity stays open on the PO

purpose: Verify delivered goods can be rejected during receipt and inspection
preconditions: Delivery under inspection
expected_result: Rejection is recorded on the receipt

purpose: Verify stock is updated for externally procured goods once the receipt is accepted, for accepted quantities
preconditions: Receipt with accepted quantity A and no unresolved discrepancy
expected_result: Stock increases by the accepted quantity A

purpose: Verify no stock is added before acceptance or for rejected quantities
preconditions: Receipt not yet accepted, or with rejected quantity R
action_or_input: Check stock before acceptance and after accepting with R rejected
expected_result: Stock unchanged before acceptance; rejected quantity R is never added to stock

purpose: Verify a discrepancy or damage can be logged against a delivery
preconditions: Delivery recorded
expected_result: Discrepancy case is created and linked to the delivery

purpose: Verify evidence attached to a discrepancy is retained
preconditions: Open discrepancy case
action_or_input: Attach evidence and reopen the case later
expected_result: Evidence is stored and retrievable

purpose: Verify a return can be initiated when goods require return under policy
preconditions: Delivered goods that require return under policy
expected_result: Return case is created

purpose: Verify a replacement can be initiated when goods require replacement under policy
preconditions: Delivered goods that require replacement under policy
expected_result: Replacement case is created

purpose: Verify vendor communication is recorded for a discrepancy/return/replacement/warranty case
preconditions: Open case
action_or_input: Record a vendor communication against it
expected_result: Communication is stored and linked to the case

purpose: Verify case status and resolution are tracked
preconditions: Open discrepancy, return, replacement or warranty case
expected_result: Current status and resolution are shown and updated

purpose: Verify required inventory adjustments are applied when a case is resolved
preconditions: Case whose policy requires an inventory adjustment
expected_result: The policy-required inventory adjustment is posted

purpose: Verify required accounting adjustments are applied when a case is resolved
preconditions: Case whose policy requires an accounting adjustment
expected_result: The policy-required accounting adjustment is posted

purpose: Verify three-way matching of PO, GRN and invoice
preconditions: PO, GRN and invoice with consistent values
expected_result: The three documents are compared and the invoice is marked matched

purpose: Verify payment can be released after delivery confirmation and invoice verification
preconditions: Delivery confirmed; invoice verified; vendor verified
expected_result: Payment is released

purpose: Verify payment release is refused when delivery is unconfirmed or invoice verification incomplete
preconditions: Case A: delivery not confirmed. Case B: invoice not verified
action_or_input: Attempt to release payment in each case
expected_result: Release is refused in both cases and no payment is made

purpose: Verify a mismatched invoice is placed on hold
preconditions: Invoice differs from PO/GRN
expected_result: Invoice status is On Hold and payment cannot be released

purpose: Verify partial payments follow configured payment rules
preconditions: Partial-payment rule configured; eligible invoice
action_or_input: Release a partial payment permitted by the rule
expected_result: Partial payment is recorded and the balance remains outstanding

purpose: Verify onboarding of a new vendor
preconditions: Authorized user
action_or_input: Onboard a vendor with required details
expected_result: Vendor master record is created

purpose: Verify vendor master data can be maintained
preconditions: Existing vendor record; authorized user
expected_result: Change is saved

purpose: Verify valid GST, bank details and compliance documents pass validation
preconditions: Vendor with valid GST, bank details and required compliance documents
expected_result: Validation passes

purpose: Verify invalid or missing GST, bank details or compliance documents are rejected
preconditions: Vendor with invalid GST, or invalid bank details, or missing compliance document
action_or_input: Submit for validation in each case
expected_result: Validation fails and the failing element is identified

purpose: Verify PO issuance to an unverified vendor is prevented
preconditions: Unverified vendor; PO ready
expected_result: Issuance is blocked

purpose: Verify payment to an unverified vendor is prevented
preconditions: Unverified vendor; otherwise payable invoice
expected_result: Payment is blocked

purpose: Verify version history is retained for vendor master changes
preconditions: Existing vendor record
expected_result: Prior and new values are retained as separate versions

purpose: Verify vendor master changes are recorded in the audit trail
preconditions: Existing vendor record
expected_result: Audit entry records the change, actor and time

purpose: Verify an inter-departmental stock transfer request can be created
preconditions: Source department holds stock; authorized user
expected_result: Request is created with source, destination, item and quantity

purpose: Verify approved transfer stock is reserved
preconditions: Approved transfer request
expected_result: Transfer quantity is reserved in the source stock

purpose: Verify an approved transfer can be dispatched
preconditions: Approved transfer with reserved stock
expected_result: Transfer is marked dispatched

purpose: Verify receipt of a transfer can be confirmed
preconditions: Dispatched transfer
expected_result: Receipt confirmation is recorded and the transfer is complete

purpose: Verify the source stock ledger is updated on completion
preconditions: Transfer of quantity Q completed
expected_result: Source ledger decreases by Q

purpose: Verify the destination stock ledger is updated on completion
preconditions: Transfer of quantity Q completed
expected_result: Destination ledger increases by Q

purpose: Verify an audit trail is retained for transfers
preconditions: Transfer taken through request to completion
expected_result: Audit entries exist for each transfer step

purpose: Verify operational reports are provided
preconditions: Purchase and stores activity data; authorized user
expected_result: Report is produced reflecting the data

purpose: Verify procurement reports are provided
preconditions: Procurement data; authorized user
expected_result: Report is produced reflecting the data

purpose: Verify stock reports are provided
preconditions: Stock data; authorized user
expected_result: Report is produced reflecting the data

purpose: Verify financial reports on procurement and payments are provided
preconditions: Procurement and payment data; authorized user
expected_result: Report is produced reflecting the data

purpose: Verify reporting is available only to authorized users
preconditions: User without report authorization
expected_result: Access is denied and no report is generated

purpose: Verify report data can be filtered by supported criteria
preconditions: Report with data covering varied criteria values
expected_result: Only matching records are shown

purpose: Verify generated reports can be exported
preconditions: Generated report
expected_result: Export file is produced with the report contents

purpose: Verify scheduled report generation
preconditions: Report schedule configured
expected_result: Report is generated automatically

purpose: Verify dashboards show real-time process status and key metrics
preconditions: Open dashboard; authorized user
action_or_input: Change a process state, then refresh the dashboard
expected_result: Dashboard shows key metrics and the updated status

purpose: Verify every report generation event is logged
preconditions: Authorized user
action_or_input: Generate one report manually and one by schedule
expected_result: A log entry exists for each generation event

purpose: Verify automated notifications for indent submission and approval events
preconditions: Notification rules configured
action_or_input: Submit an indent and approve it
expected_result: Notifications are generated for the submission and for the approval

purpose: Verify alerts for dispatch, receipt, invoice and payment status events
preconditions: Notification rules configured
action_or_input: Trigger dispatch, receipt, invoice and payment events
expected_result: An alert is sent for each of the four events

purpose: Verify SLA reminder and escalation notifications are sent
preconditions: Pending approval with SLA reminder and escalation conditions configured
action_or_input: Trigger the reminder then the escalation condition
expected_result: Both a reminder and an escalation notification are sent

purpose: Verify communication history generated by the module is retained
preconditions: Notifications previously sent
expected_result: Sent notifications are retained and retrievable

purpose: Verify a complete audit trail of module actions is maintained
preconditions: Perform actions across indent, PO, GRN and payment
expected_result: Each action appears with actor, action and timestamp

purpose: Verify internal audit of purchase and stores records within authorized scope
preconditions: Authorized auditor with internal audit scope
expected_result: Records are accessible for audit

purpose: Verify an auditor cannot access records outside the authorized scope
preconditions: Authorized auditor; records outside the auditor’s scope
expected_result: Access is denied

purpose: Verify statutory audit of purchase and stores records
preconditions: Authorized auditor with statutory audit scope
expected_result: Records are accessible for statutory audit

purpose: Verify RBAC allows module functions to permitted roles
preconditions: User holding a role permitted for a function
expected_result: Access is granted

purpose: Verify RBAC denies functions and information to roles not permitted
preconditions: User without the required role
action_or_input: Attempt a restricted function or open restricted information
expected_result: Access is denied and nothing is changed or disclosed

purpose: Verify an action violating a configured procurement-policy rule is blocked
preconditions: Procurement-policy business rule configured
action_or_input: Perform an action that violates the rule
expected_result: Action is blocked and the rule violation is reported

purpose: Verify an action violating a configured financial-policy rule is blocked
preconditions: Financial-policy business rule configured
action_or_input: Perform an action that violates the rule
expected_result: Action is blocked and the rule violation is reported
